comments.author: devilkit
comments.body:
Just completed this quest and ran into a few hiccups which below will explain how to fix.

First you must go in order Nantes > Ragusa > Istanbul
Second all dresses to turn in must be the green color dress, like the icon above. If you are in possession of a different color dress change it back to the green color using a sewing kit / dye.

comments.body: as long as the dress has the exact same name and is green it should work. it's the same item number game-wise, it just has bonus dura. The reason why the other colors don't work is because they are technically a different item (say it's item #1138 for a green one and #1139 for a blue one)

comments.body: Hmm, a friend pulled this with only French, 15950 Trade fame, and no Italian or Sewing skill. comments.author: Will_Adams
comments.body: Note: If the person you are fleeted to to get your skill boost from has completed this quest, it will not show for you, because only the other quest for the job card("Royal Warrant Craftsman") will show for them after they've completed this quest once. It's the same with any job card quest where there are 2 quests for the same card, ie: Alchemist, once anyone has done the quest "Learning From Paracelsus" and has gotten their Alchemist job card once, no one fleeted to that character can pull that quest, because that quest cannot be taken by the person who has completed it, they now can only do the quest "Fostering the Art of Alchemy".
